purpose: Open one bounded Grave Memory route from the golden first slice, let the player read remains without consuming them, and return through the same living fold without reviving the archived multi-system route chain.
routeQuestion: Can the player learn from remains without becoming trapped inside them?

interaction.safeTransferRule: retain a readable memory thread; consume no protected remains

returnFold.interaction: A / E after the route reading is complete

playerFacingLanguage.read_old_core_husk: Approach the old Core husk and Pulse to read it.
playerFacingLanguage.pulse_memory_silt: Pulse the drifting memory silt before trying to hold it.
playerFacingLanguage.stabilize_memory_silt: Hold Stabilize near the read silt until its trace settles.
playerFacingLanguage.read_protective_scar: Pulse the scar plate. It protects the remains; it is not a door.
playerFacingLanguage.read_inheritance_seed: Pulse the inheritance seed without taking it.
playerFacingLanguage.memory_reading_settling: Let the four readings settle together.
playerFacingLanguage.return_fold_ready: The memory is retained. Return to the entry fold and press A.
